resources.string: Show the GameNative Duo panel on the second screen while the game runs. Hidden anyway when External display mode or swap is on.

Show one tall game screen across both screens: the upper part on top, the lower part below (tap it to click). Set the screen size to %1$d×%2$d and use a game or mod that puts its UI in the lower part. Replaces the bottom-screen panel.
Show one tall game screen across both screens. No second screen found on this device.
